source_spans.quoted_text: No person shall circumvent a technological measure that effectively controls access to a work protected under this title.
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: The prohibition contained in the preceding sentence shall take effect at the end of the 2-year period beginning on the date of the enactment of this chapter.
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: The prohibition contained in subparagraph (A) shall not apply to persons who are users of a copyrighted work which is in a particular class of works, if such persons are, or are likely to be in the succeeding 3-year period, adversely affected by virtue of such prohibition in their ability to make noninfringing uses of that par- ticular class of works under this title, as deter- mined under subparagraph (C).
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: During the 2-year period described in sub- paragraph (A), and during each succeeding 3- year period, the Librarian of Congress, upon the recommendation of the Register of Copyrights, who shall consult with the Assistant Secretary for Communications and Information of the De- partment of Commerce and report and comment on his or her views in making such recommenda- tion, shall make the determination in a rule- making proceeding for purposes of subparagraph (B) of whether persons who are users of a copy- righted work are, or are likely to be in the suc- ceeding 3-year period, adversely affected by the prohibition under subparagraph (A) in their abil- ity to make noninfringing uses under this title of a particular class of copyrighted works.
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: A nonprofit library, archives, or educational insti- tution which gains access to a commercially ex- ploited copyrighted work solely in order to make a good faith determination of whether to acquire a copy of that work for the sole purpose of engaging in conduct permitted under this title shall not be in violation of subsection (a)(1)(A).
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: to ‘‘circumvent a technological meas- ure’’ means to descramble a scrambled work, to decrypt an encrypted work, or otherwise to avoid, bypass, remove, deactivate, or impair a technological measure, without the authority of the copyright owner
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

source_spans.quoted_text: Every telecommunications carrier has a duty to protect the confidentiality of proprietary in- formation of, and relating to, other tele- communication carriers, equipment manufac- turers, and customers, including telecommuni- cation carriers reselling telecommunications services provided by a telecommunications car- rier.
source_spans.text_basis: pdftotext -raw UTF-8; whitespace collapsed with re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
